note: The hound quiz: every archetype is a spec fragment the real builder menu accepts (tests/test_hounds_quiz_library.py validates each one). The English shown beside each is generated from the fragment by src/hounds/english/render.py, never written here. Paper only: a hound is a rule graded in public, not a prediction, and no archetype is known to win.

archetypes.name: Revenge Tour
archetypes.pitch: Backs the team facing a hot streak. Maybe the cold side bites back; the record will say.
archetypes.short: Backs teams facing an opponent on a hot streak

archetypes.name: Primetime Underdog
archetypes.pitch: Night games, plus money, underdogs only. The lights are on and so is the dog.
archetypes.short: Bets underdogs in night games

archetypes.name: Steam Chaser
archetypes.pitch: Follows the line. Only bets the side the market has been moving toward since the first capture.
archetypes.short: Follows the way the line is moving

archetypes.name: Fade the Public Darling
archetypes.pitch: Takes the underdog after the market piles onto the favourite. We read line moves, not crowd tickets.
archetypes.short: Backs underdogs when the market leans to the favorite

archetypes.name: Tired Legs
archetypes.pitch: Backs a rested team against one that played yesterday. Short rest, short fuse.
archetypes.short: Backs rested teams against opponents who played yesterday

archetypes.name: Road Warriors
archetypes.pitch: Road teams that win away from home. Packs the bags, takes the points.
archetypes.short: Backs road teams that win away from home

generic.short: Bets road teams at fair prices

archetypes.name: Home Cooking
archetypes.pitch: Home sides with a strong record at home. Sleeps in its own bed, bites in its own yard.
archetypes.short: Backs home teams with strong home records

generic.short: Bets home teams at fair prices

archetypes.name: Hot Bat Props
archetypes.pitch: Hitters with a hit in each of their last 3 games, over their hits or total bases.
archetypes.short: Bets overs on hitters riding a hit streak

archetypes.name: Strikeout King
archetypes.pitch: Pitcher strikeout overs when his last 5 starts average above the line.
archetypes.short: Bets pitcher strikeout overs when recent form is strong

archetypes.name: Windy Overs
archetypes.pitch: Game totals over, in open-air parks, when the forecast wind is 12 mph or more.
archetypes.short: Bets overs in open-air parks when it is windy

archetypes.name: Full Moon Chaos
archetypes.pitch: Underdogs, plus money, only under a full moon. Science has not been consulted.
archetypes.short: Bets underdogs only when the moon is full

archetypes.name: Coin Flip Gremlin
archetypes.pitch: Plus-money underdogs, but only when a seeded coin lands its way. Pure chaos, fully logged.
archetypes.short: Bets underdogs when a seeded coin says yes

archetypes.name: Lucky Letters
archetypes.pitch: Bets the team whose name starts with its lucky letter. S by default; pick your own.
archetypes.short: Bets teams whose name starts with your letter

archetypes.name: Numerology Oracle
archetypes.pitch: Backs the team whose name adds up closest to the date's number. Gematria, no apologies.
archetypes.short: Picks teams by name numerology and the date

archetypes.name: Sunday Funday
archetypes.pitch: Underdogs on Sundays. Plus money, snacks optional.
archetypes.short: Bets underdogs on Sundays

archetypes.name: Plus Money Only
archetypes.pitch: Moneylines at plus money, either side. If it pays more than even, the dog will look at it.
archetypes.short: Bets any side that pays plus money

archetypes.name: Chalk Eater
archetypes.pitch: Favourites only, at short prices, and the hard cap stays at -199. Never -200 or worse.
archetypes.short: Bets favorites at short prices, never -200 or worse

archetypes.name: Thursday Night Gremlins
archetypes.pitch: NFL Thursday games, underdogs on the spread. Short weeks make strange games.
archetypes.short: Bets underdog spreads in Thursday games

archetypes.name: Monday Night Mischief
archetypes.pitch: NFL Monday nights, underdogs, any market that pays. The last game of the weekend.
archetypes.short: Bets underdogs in Monday games

archetypes.name: Cold Front Unders
archetypes.pitch: Game totals under in open-air parks when the forecast is 50 degrees or colder.
archetypes.short: Bets unders in open-air parks when it is cold

archetypes.name: Heat Wave Overs
archetypes.pitch: Game totals over in open-air parks when it is 85 degrees or hotter at first pitch.
archetypes.short: Bets overs in open-air parks when it is hot

archetypes.name: Rainy Day Unders
archetypes.pitch: Game totals under when the forecast chance of rain is 40 percent or more.
archetypes.short: Bets unders when rain is likely

archetypes.name: Matinee Mutt
archetypes.pitch: Day-game underdogs. Gets up early, takes the price.
archetypes.short: Bets underdogs in day games

archetypes.name: Hot Hand Hound
archetypes.pitch: Rides a team that has won 3 or more in a row. The streak is the whole idea.
archetypes.short: Backs teams on a winning streak

archetypes.name: Bounce-Back Biscuit
archetypes.pitch: Underdogs coming off 3 or more losses in a row. Rock bottom is a price.
archetypes.short: Backs underdogs coming off a losing streak

archetypes.name: Red-Eye Special
archetypes.pitch: Backs the team facing an opponent that has travelled 1,500 miles or more since its last game.
archetypes.short: Backs teams whose opponent just traveled far

archetypes.name: Short Week Slayer
archetypes.pitch: NFL teams facing an opponent playing on 5 days of rest or fewer.
archetypes.short: Backs teams facing an opponent on short rest

archetypes.name: Bye Week Believer
archetypes.pitch: NFL teams coming off a bye, 10 or more days of rest. Fresh legs, fresh hope.
archetypes.short: Backs teams coming off a bye week

archetypes.name: Field Goal Fiend
archetypes.pitch: Football spreads of 3 points or less. Close games, one kick from either result.
archetypes.short: Bets close spreads, three points or fewer

archetypes.name: Touchdown Dog
archetypes.pitch: Football underdogs getting 7 or more points. A big number is a big cushion.
archetypes.short: Bets underdogs getting seven or more points

archetypes.name: Under the Lights
archetypes.pitch: Night game totals, under. The sun goes down, the score goes with it; allegedly.
archetypes.short: Bets unders in night games

archetypes.name: Total Steam Chaser
archetypes.pitch: Game totals, but only the side the market has been moving toward.
archetypes.short: Follows the line on game totals

archetypes.name: Weekend Warrior
archetypes.pitch: Plus-money underdogs on Saturdays and Sundays. Weekdays are for resting.
archetypes.short: Bets underdogs on Saturday and Sunday

archetypes.name: Fresh Legs Favourite
archetypes.pitch: Favourites at short prices with 2 or more days of rest. Cap stays at -199.
archetypes.short: Bets rested favorites at short prices

archetypes.name: Home Dog Howl
archetypes.pitch: Home underdogs only, plus money. The crowd noise is a rumour, the price is a number.
archetypes.short: Bets home underdogs at plus money

archetypes.name: Long Name Louie
archetypes.pitch: Bets teams whose name has 12 or more letters. Silly on purpose, graded like everything else.
archetypes.short: Bets teams with long names, just for fun

archetypes.name: Run Producer
archetypes.pitch: Over on hits + runs + RBIs for hitters who average 2 or more per game on the box scores we have.
archetypes.short: Bets overs on hitters who produce runs

archetypes.name: Long Ball Dreamer
archetypes.pitch: Home run overs at big prices, for hitters who average a quarter of a homer a game or more.
archetypes.short: Bets home run overs at big prices

archetypes.name: New Moon Unders
archetypes.pitch: Game totals under, only on a new moon. Dark sky, quiet bats, no evidence.
archetypes.short: Bets unders only on a new moon

archetypes.name: Contrarian Corgi
archetypes.pitch: Takes the underdog when the market moved toward the favourite and the dog is rested. Small legs, big opinions.
archetypes.short: Backs rested underdogs when the line moves against them

archetypes.name: Form Filter
archetypes.pitch: Backs the team that won at least 7 of its last 10 against one that won 5 or fewer.
archetypes.short: Backs teams in strong form over cold opponents

archetypes.name: Two-Rule Twin
archetypes.pitch: Two rules in one dog: road underdogs on the moneyline, and unders on cold days. Shows how a dog can mix.
archetypes.short: Road underdogs plus cold-weather unders in one hound

personalities.name: Underdog Hunter
personalities.pitch: Plus money or nothing. Sniffs out the dog everyone else walked past.

personalities.name: Chalk Eater
personalities.pitch: Short prices, favourites, steady. Never -200 or worse, ever.
personalities.tagline: Eats the chalk. Never -200 or worse.

personalities.name: Chaos Agent
personalities.pitch: Lets a seeded coin decide. Every pick is logged, nothing is explained.

personalities.name: Stats Nerd
personalities.pitch: Wants recent form, rest and numbers before it commits to anything.

personalities.name: Steam Chaser
personalities.pitch: Follows the line. Backs whatever way the market has been moving.

personalities.name: Mystic
personalities.pitch: Numerology, moons and hunches. Not a prediction, a vibe, graded in public.
personalities.tagline: Reads the stars, then the odds.

markets.name: Spreads and run lines
markets.pitch: Win by enough, or lose by less.

markets.name: Game totals
markets.pitch: Over or under, never mind who wins.

markets.name: Player props
markets.pitch: A hitter or a pitcher, one stat. MLB only.

markets.name: A bit of everything
markets.pitch: Moneylines, spreads and totals in one dog.

price_comforts.name: Short prices
price_comforts.pitch: Favourite territory, -199 to -110. Never -200 or worse.

price_comforts.name: Around even
price_comforts.pitch: Close to a coin flip: -130 to +130.

price_comforts.name: Plus money
price_comforts.pitch: Pays more than it risks: +100 to +250.

price_comforts.name: Long shots
price_comforts.pitch: +250 and up. Loses a lot, pays when it lands.

quirks.name: Warm weather
quirks.pitch: Only when the forecast is 75 degrees or more at first pitch. MLB.

quirks.name: Chilly games
quirks.pitch: Only when the forecast is 55 degrees or colder. MLB.

quirks.name: Windy days
quirks.pitch: Only when the forecast wind is 12 mph or more. MLB.

quirks.name: Dry days
quirks.pitch: Only when the chance of rain is 20 percent or less. MLB.

quirks.name: Full moon
quirks.pitch: Only when the moon is full. Yes, really.

quirks.name: New moon
quirks.pitch: Only when the moon is new.

quirks.name: Lucky letter
quirks.pitch: Only teams whose name starts with your letter. Pick it below.

quirks.name: Numerology
quirks.pitch: Only the team whose name adds up closest to the date's number.

quirks.name: Coin flip
quirks.pitch: A seeded coin has to say yes first, 50 percent of the time.

quirks.name: Night games
quirks.pitch: Games that start at 5pm Eastern or later.

quirks.name: Well rested
quirks.pitch: Only when the team it backs has 2 or more days of rest.

quirks.name: Tired opponent
quirks.pitch: Only when the opponent played yesterday (MLB: 0 days off).

quirks.name: Line moving my way
quirks.pitch: Only when the market has moved toward the pick since the first capture.

timings.name: Early bird
timings.pitch: Checks the board 3 hours before the start.

timings.name: Right before the game
timings.pitch: Checks the board 1 hour before the start.
